objective.statement: Establish the Riemann Hypothesis through an independently auditable original-zeta Weil-form argument.

governance.selection: Choose the highest-priority actionable open obligation from the dependency graph, not the numerically greatest checkpoint or the last conversation topic. Any change of active_obligation requires a justified manifest edit.
governance.ranking_note: priority is an explicit research judgement, not proof standing or numerical progress.
governance.closure_rule: Close only upon evidence meeting the stated mathematical acceptance condition on the original object, support, domain and norm. A reformulation, numerical screen, partial sector bound, or passing CI alone is insufficient.
governance.evidence_rule: Keep mathematical standing separate from CI state, Lean coverage and independent review. Never treat another method's checkpoint as automatic transfer of scope.
governance.thread_rule: Unqualified NF advances the canonical active obligation; explicitly scoped local requests retain their scope. Method pivots need no new conversation but must preserve custody and update the manifest.
